title: Research: fuse complex factory to 32 operations (no new kappa)
body:
## Summary

Two exact three-register identities reduce Alluri's accepted PR681 coordinate-total circuit from 34 to 32 scalar operations. Fresh reconstruction verifies the replacement in all fourteen raw PR622 factory blocks and their inverse cleanups.

Finite circuit construction; **No new κ**. The selected conditional κ remains 0.001661634653669567.

## Exact result

Compared with PR681's 34-operation circuit:

| Complete raw invocation | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Compensated scalar operations | 15,488 | 15,432 |
| Emitted scalar macros, either orientation | 15,512 | 15,456 |
| Forward real-component primitives | 160,296 | 159,848 |
| Inverse-transpose real-component primitives | 160,344 | 159,896 |

This saves 56 scalar operations and 448 real-component primitives per orientation under the inherited lowering. Every source read, coefficient operation, work clear and inverse cleanup remains charged.

The exact map, 492 helpers, 716 arbitrary native input columns, compensation, helper widths, paid profile and phase-edge inventory are preserved. Conservative whole-word prefix bounds decrease from 68,417 to 39,090 forward and from 1,649,462 to 1,301,331 backward.

Under the stronger accepted PR696 copy/unit lowering, the local comparator gives a marginal saving of 224 primitives per orientation. The 448 and 224 figures are alternatives, not additive savings; the PR696 whole-program invoice is not reissued here.

## What is new

The contractions cross noncommuting scalar-macro boundaries in the existing 34-gate word. This is a different search class from PR681's Gaussian resynthesis and commuting-generator collection.

PR802 independently audits the earlier 87→34 replacement. This contribution changes that witness to 32 operations and credits its predecessor savings separately. Recent PR883/901 concern different X4 target-pair maps. No pending implementation is imported.

Assignment seed 23 selected the complex track and initial block 9. The bounded scan completed three passes: 8,801 ADD triples, 325 movable triples and 1,950 ordered two-member candidates considered. Two contractions were accepted; the final declared neighborhood was empty. This is not global circuit optimality.

- PR696 comparator: 5a3f983715027c4fd83f50bc9001d4b18463bed1

SOURCE-PINS.json binds 25 source/context files by SHA256. Gzip inputs are pinned by decompressed payload. All executable dependencies are already present in the starting tree.

## Reproduction

From the repository root, using Python 3.11+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-factory-fused-seed23/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_FACTORY_FUSION windows=14 gates=34->32 saved_with_cleanup=56 primitives_saved=448 columns=716 controls=71 no_new_kappa
```

The command reconstructs both complete raw words, runs native/emitted/local admission, and checks the full deterministic receipt. Inherited subprocess assertions remain enabled even under top-level -O.

## Validation actually executed

On CPython 3.12.14/Linux:

- Full verifier passed normally and with isolated optimized Python.
- Every local matrix orientation and all 716 native input columns passed.
- All 71 new rejection controls passed, including every gate deletion/sign mutation, wrong ordering/frame, endpoint-neutral growth/cost inflation, and missing cleanup.
- Four inherited local controls passed for each complete word.
- Bounded search reproduction passed.
- Package checks passed: minimal relocation with spaces, payload-preserving gzip repacking, and seven corruption/output-preservation controls.
- make selected-record-check and staged whitespace checks passed.

Local primitive denominator depths remain 1,2,2,1 across the four variants; exact prefix row-L1 maxima remain 12,8,10,12.

The general make verify, selected frontier799 cold replay, full historical hosted replay, remote CI and Lean were not run.

## Scope and remaining obligations

Only research/complex-factory-fused-seed23/ is added. No selected certificate, production generator, predecessor package or upstream/ file changes.

This verifies the historical raw factory. Transport through later gauge, prefix, frame and cold-end recipes remains undone. Fresh phase lowering, whole-owner hosting, selected global invoices and outer assembly are separate obligations. Local scalar grid checks are not a complete compiler precision certificate.

All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit-supplier assumptions remain inherited. No multiplication theorem, practical runtime improvement or globally optimal circuit is claimed.

Public PR metadata was refreshed through #915. No matching new factory contraction or pinned sprint coordination issue was found; the local claim records the result and branch destination.
